name: Calendar Notes
description: Read-only calendar (Day/Week/Work Week/Two Weeks/Month/Two Months) with persistent handwritten notes per date.
args: log=/tmp/calendar-notes-launch.log; echo "[launch] $(date) cwd=$(pwd)" >>"$log" 2>/dev/null; chmod +x ./remarkable-calendar-notes 2>>"$log"; exec ./remarkable-calendar-notes run 2>>"$log"
